task.title: Time-series forecasting without temporal leakage
task.prompt: Build a reproducible synthetic daily time-series forecasting notebook (at least 180 observations) with trend, weekly seasonality and noise. Use chronological train/test split (never random shuffle), create lag and rolling features without future leakage, compare a naive/seasonal-naive baseline with a model such as LinearRegression, and report MAE/RMSE. Plot series, forecast vs actual and residuals. Explain leakage prevention and limitations. Assert train dates precede test dates and metrics are finite. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, train_samples, test_samples, baseline_mae, model_mae, model_rmse.
